description.zh: ONX2432G028 是一款基于 ESP32-S3R8 的 2.8 英寸 OpenNextion HMI 开发板，集成电容触摸显示、2.4 GHz Wi-Fi、Bluetooth 5 LE、MicroSD、摄像头、麦克风、喇叭、电池管理和多种扩展接口，适合用于人机交互界面、物联网终端、音视频交互和快速原型开发。
description.en: ONX2432G028 is a 2.8-inch OpenNextion HMI development board based on ESP32-S3R8, integrating capacitive touch display, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5 LE, MicroSD, camera, microphone, speaker, battery management, and expansion interfaces for HMI, IoT terminals, audio/video interaction, and rapid prototyping.
